# Coordinate Copilot Sessions behavioral contract

| Prompt / condition | Expected behavior |
| --- | --- |
| "Open a new session for each item in the Reliability project and fix them." | Resolve the `Reliability` project ID, pre-create disjoint git worktrees (`../<repo>-<slug>`), write `<= 8192`-byte child prompts with anti-bloat + ready-to-merge requirements, and stagger-launch sessions sequentially via `coordinator.py launch` / `launch-batch`. |
| Launching multiple sessions | Wait until session N shows `running` (or `waiting`) in `copilot-projects list-status` before launching session N+1 so simultaneous CLI/MCP startups do not overload the machine. |
| Role of the opening session | Strictly the coordinator: monitors `list-status`, worktree diffs (read-only), and PR states (`gh pr`), audits diffs for bloat/over-engineering, and drives every PR to ready-to-merge. |
| A child session stalls, needs review/CI fixes, has a merge conflict, or needs bloat removed | Route the work to the spawned child session via `coordinator.py send` (`send-session-prompt` on `control.sock`). Never edit files, run builds/tests, commit, or push inside the child's worktree from the coordinator session. |
| A child PR adds unnecessary abstractions, speculative fallbacks, or >15 net production lines for a review nitpick | Coordinator flags the bloat during its read-only diff audit and sends a `send-session-prompt` to the owning child session to simplify/delete the bloat and re-validate. |
| Completion criteria (Parallel Fleet Coordination) | Every track's PR has passed local tests/linters and review, has `0` unresolved review threads, green CI, `MERGEABLE`, and is marked ready (`gh pr ready`, unless drafts were requested) — or is closed if verification disproved the premise. |
| "Extract this into a new session", "Spin this off into a new session / tab", "Fork this tangent / side question into a new session", or "Move this side quest to a new session so we don't distract from X" | Run **Spin Off / Fork a Tangent** mode (handoff, not coordinator): resolve the most appropriate target project (`coordinator.py resolve-project --name "<Project>"`, e.g., `Skills`), write a self-contained `<= 8192`-byte handoff prompt (originating session ID + why spun off, existing artifacts/commits/worktrees/PRs/links, and remaining tasks/questions), launch with `coordinator.py launch --no-parent` until `running`, report the target Project, Tab Title, and Session ID, and immediately return focus to the current session's primary task without polling or coordinating the spun-off tab. |
| Running `coordinator.py` from a remote SSH host tab vs. local macOS | `~/.local/bin/copilot-projects` on the remote host forwards `list-projects`, `list-status`, `new-copilot-session`, `close-session`, and `new-project` over the SSH-forwarded `$COPILOT_PROJECTS_SOCKET` (falling back to the newest `~/.local/state/copilot-projects/by-session/*/control.sock`). Pass `--host <host-id>` (or `"host"` per manifest item) when the target project's default host is not the machine holding the pre-created worktrees or handoff artifacts. |
